info.title: USAgentLeads API
info.description: Search and retrieve agent and brokerage contacts with shared account credits, safe retries, and asynchronous exports. v2 remains available separately.

post.description: Acquires new contacts using the shared account credits; 1 per agent or 2 per brokerage. Already-owned records are free. Retry the SAME UUID key and body to recover the saved selection.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Save before sending. Changed payloads with this key return 409; never create a fresh key after an ambiguous timeout.

post.description: Queue up to 5,000 records selected by filters or IDs. The selection is frozen at creation. No upfront credit reservation: credits settle atomically when the result is prepared. A lower balance at preparation fails the job with no acquisition. Store and reuse the same request key.

get.description: Authenticated download of a prepared JSON or CSV snapshot. No new credit charge. Results expire 30 days after preparation. Later suppressions are reapplied. CSV templates include required location attribution and formula-safe cells.
